title: Bigfoot rumours in D sector
place_text: D sector, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California

tellings.quote: to scare the new guys was Bigfoot's out there and he's he's going to get you, but there was nothing about UFOs or even talk about it that I know.

plain: Richard Barth, who in 1964 was a guard for nuclear missiles at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the talk in an area of the base called D sector. He says the joke used to scare new guards was that Bigfoot, the legendary ape-like creature, was out there and would get them. But he says, as far as he knew, nobody talked about UFOs at all.
